name: Hornero System Insight
description: System Insight: a desktop instrument over the shared system provider: a CPU oscilloscope from the shared Telemetry history, segmented meters, per-core load strips and temperatures. Real telemetry only.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: The oscilloscope shrinks (down to 48 px) on short frames so the temperature row is no longer clipped.
Settings: show or hide the GPU and disk meters, and show temperatures in Celsius or Fahrenheit.
Taller default frame so the per-core strip is drawn instead of a header with nothing under it.
Initial release: CPU oscilloscope, segmented meters, per-core strips and temperatures over the shared system provider (PluginKit 3 desktop widget).

showCores.description: Show one vertical load strip per logical CPU when the widget is tall enough.

showTemperatures.description: Show CPU/GPU temperatures and memory use when the system provider reports them.

warnPercent.description: Usage percent at or above which a meter segment turns signal (the visual language default is 85).

showGpu.description: Show the GPU meter (it already reads as unavailable when the system provider has no GPU data).

temperatureUnit.description: Unit for the CPU and GPU temperatures. The provider reports Celsius; Fahrenheit is a display conversion.
